comment_dispositions.behavioral_evidence: Actual Manual retired/foreign non-pool dirty-entry fixtures each pass3 under race: full ancestor sizing, dirty clear, current completed inspection, full software RGBA/geometry equality and subsequent healthy local recovery. Removing only the Core caller fallback compiles and fails exact sizing/dirty-clear/pixel assertions.

finding.message: Inside the loop over layoutDirty, a stale or foreign-scene text makes LayoutLocal return false. Earlier texts may already have had SizeUp/SizeDown/SizeFinal run. Unlike the earlier stamp-mismatch branch, this return does not set g.layout.valid = false, does not schedule host.Update(), and does not clear layoutDirty. The stale entry therefore stays in layoutDirty, and the next local layout attempt hits the same failure. If the caller does not guarantee a full layout after a false return, the grid keeps a half-updated layout.
finding.suggestion: On this failure path, invalidate the local layout the same way as the stamp-mismatch branch: set g.layout.valid = false, clear g.layoutDirty, and call g.host.Update() before returning false. Alternatively, validate every entry in layoutDirty before sizing any of them.
finding.title: LayoutLocal bails out mid-loop without invalidating layout state

comment_dispositions.reason: Core LocalLayoutRoot explicitly requires false when full sizing/style/layout is required. drainLocalLayouts returns fallback=true on that false; doUpdate immediately invokes fullLayoutUpdate(layoutRenderUpdate). Ordinary Grid Position recomputes all panes/cells and clears layoutDirty. No conditional unsupported caller exists in the framework path; partial local work is superseded by the full pass.

finding.message: The Scene struct now uses atomic.Bool, but the patch to core/scene.go adds no import hunk for sync/atomic. If scene.go does not already import it, the package will not compile.
finding.suggestion: Confirm that scene.go already imports "sync/atomic". If it does not, add an import hunk for it to the patch.
finding.title: atomic.Bool is used without a visible sync/atomic import

comment_dispositions.reason: Both the stage40 baseline and current scene.go already import sync/atomic; the baseline already uses frameTrace atomic.Pointer. No new import hunk is needed for atomic.Bool. The changed declaration exists literally in the patch, so a quote-not-found reason is not relied on.

comment_dispositions.behavioral_evidence: Approved Core V2 tests include concurrent atomic readers with one writer, full-callback fences, later-request survival and abnormal retry. These do not promise safety for concurrent unsynchronized widget mutations.

finding.message: The fence is documented as readable from any thread without the render context. In setFlag the atomic and the flag word are updated separately, with the set path storing the fence first and the clear path storing it last. Concurrent set and clear can interleave to leave sceneNeedsLayout set while the fence reads false. An inspector would then treat native geometry as stable during a pending layout. Any other code path that clears sceneNeedsLayout through setFlag also drops the fence prematurely.
finding.suggestion: Serialize fence updates, for example with a mutex or a single atomic state word. Alternatively, restrict fence clearing to fullLayoutUpdate and never clear it from setFlag.
finding.title: Layout fence and flag are updated non-atomically as a pair

comment_dispositions.reason: The claimed interleaving requires concurrent native set/clear writers, violating originating-render-context/exclusive-construction mutation ownership. Readers only query atomic GlobalLayoutPending. Under one writer, setting publishes true before changing layout state; fullLayoutUpdate consumes only the flag while retaining the fence through callbacks, clears only after normal completion without a later request, and restores the fence on abnormal unwind. The generic clear branch has no production sceneNeedsLayout clear caller; supported full clearing is explicit. Real patch evidence exists, so quote matching is not the basis of adjudication.
source_evidence: core/local_layout.go request contract requires originating RC/exclusive construction
core/update.go requires AsyncLock/Unlock for independent goroutine mutation
core/scene.go:175-192 publishes set fence first and clear fence last
core/render.go:188-205 single-writer full layout consumption and reentrant/abnormal preservation
